recognize_zh: 血片中可見大型芽細胞，核質比高、染色質細緻，細胞質深嗜鹼性且邊緣有泡狀突起（cytoplasmic blebs），呈巨核芽細胞樣特徵；配合唐氏症新生兒臨床背景，符合短暫性異常骨髓生成（TAM）。
features: Large blasts with high N:C ratio and round to slightly irregular nuclei
Finely dispersed chromatin; nucleoli not prominent
Deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm with irregular borders and cytoplasmic blebs/pseudopod-like projections (megakaryoblastic features)
Smaller blast with similar cytoplasmic budding at right
Band neutrophil at lower left; thick area of smear with crowded erythrocytes
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating blasts of variable size with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, fine chromatin and deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm with irregular borders and cytoplasmic blebs, features suggestive of megakaryoblastic differentiation. A band neutrophil is also present. In a neonate with Down syndrome, these findings are consistent with transient abnormal myelopoiesis; confirmation of megakaryoblastic immunophenotype (CD41/CD61) and GATA1 mutation is recommended, and clinical follow-up is needed given the risk of subsequent myeloid leukemia of Down syndrome.

ddx.dx: Myeloid leukemia associated with Down syndrome
ddx.vs: Blasts look the same; ML-DS typically presents after the neonatal period (usually before age 4) with persistent disease, often preceded by an MDS-like phase, rather than spontaneous resolution.

ddx.dx: Acute megakaryoblastic leukemia in non-Down syndrome children
ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps; absence of trisomy 21 and GATA1 mutation and presence of fusions such as CBFA2T3::GLIS2 or RBM15::MRTFA distinguish it.
Lymphoblasts have scant, less basophilic cytoplasm without blebbing and express TdT and B-lineage markers rather than CD41/CD61.

ddx.dx: Neonatal leukemoid reaction or congenital infection
ddx.vs: Shows left-shifted maturing granulocytes with few or no blasts and lacks basophilic blebbing blasts.
